note: productization STEP 4: moved out of scripts/cost_tracker.py's hardcoded PRICING table into this tracked config file, one row per model family and tier. claude-sonnet keeps the exact prior code constant ($3.00/$15.00); gpt-4o and qwen-local also keep their prior code constants unchanged. claude-opus and claude-haiku are NEW rows (the prior table collapsed all Claude tiers into one 'claude' family at Sonnet rates); their values are Anthropic first-party list prices as of this file's date, cited in docs/fix/STEP_4_REPORT.md. Cache multipliers (cache_read_multiplier, cache_write_multiplier for Anthropic; cached_input_multiplier for OpenAI) are the same values already computed inline in cost_tracker.py::_calc_cost (0.1x / 1.25x / 0.5x), moved here so the whole pricing model lives in one tracked place. `backend` on each row is the authoritative provider key (matches AgentWrapper.backend / config/agent_registry.json's backend field) used to find the most-expensive-known-row fallback for an unrecognized model id of that backend; `match` is a separate list of substrings used only to identify a model id's specific row. Verify these numbers against the provider's current list price before billing anything real.
